notes: Frames 0-5 come from the edited rifleman carry sheet and cycle while the Machine Gunner is moving; runtime rotates only those movement frames 90 degrees left and renders them at the smaller movementWorldScale.

Frame 6 reuses a carry frame so setup starts from the same carried MG pose. The runtime strip scales frames 6-8 to 84% around the cell center to smooth the visual size transition into the deployed poses, then scales all setup frames 6-11 to 85% of that state so the setup animation matches the movement sprite scale more closely.
Frames 7-11 come from the deploy-only generation and are selected over the client setup animation duration. Frames 7 and 8 have isolated left-edge crop artifacts cleared from the runtime strip.
The checked-in runtime strip keeps the raw generated color; the client applies the same 70% brightness frame-strip color target used by Rifleman and Rifleman Panzerfaust at texture load time.
Frames 12-14 are a three-frame no-muzzle-flare firing recoil strip transformed from the generated recoil sheet before the production strip is downsampled to 64x64 RGBA8 cells.
The deployed source points south/down in the sheet; runtime subtracts PI/2 from weaponFacing for setup/deployed frame-strip rotation.

Pass 05 follows the Rifleman whole-frame pipeline: every visible RGB pixel comes from the accepted ImageGen white carry, deploy, or recoil artwork rather than mixing a recolor layer with the old green sprite.

The pass-05 pipeline retains only the pass-01 960x64 frame geometry and alpha channel byte-for-byte, and records the exact runtime-size whole-frame color guide plus transfer mask for contract verification.

Pass 06 rebuilds each frame directly from the high-resolution source alpha and ImageGen color at 160x160, matching Rifleman's linear runtime resolution while preserving the old MG world-space footprint through proportionally reduced draw scales.

The 2.5x runtime resolution increase changes the strip from 960x64 to 2400x160; worldScale changes from 0.84 to 0.336 and movementWorldScale changes from 0.612 to 0.2448, so both deployed and moving canvas extents remain exact.
